recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Build a portrait-first mobile browser drawing game called **Neon Bestie Doodle Era**. Preserve a simple freehand drawing loop: the player drags on a canvas to draw smooth line strokes, chooses among five colors, chooses three brush sizes, toggles an eraser, undoes the last stroke, and resets the canvas. The game should feel relaxing and anti-anxiety, with no fail state and no hard scoring beyond a stroke counter.

Present the game as an anime lo-fi neon city sketchbook: pastel dream paper, decora-kei brush controls, soft girl palette, satirical meme copy using “bestie” and “era,” an animated procedural skyline, moon, clouds, neon signs, twinkling stars, and small celebratory feedback when a line is completed. Keep controls large, one-thumb friendly, readable, and safe for 4:7 to 9:16 portrait screens.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
The source is a browser drawing game: a full-screen canvas accepts pointer drag strokes, supports five brush colors, three brush sizes, eraser mode, undo, reset, stroke count, transient feedback GIF/SFX, and mobile-safe bottom toolbar controls.

## Protected mechanics
- Drag on the drawing surface creates freehand line segments.
- Selected color and brush size affect new strokes.
- Eraser removes drawn pixels using destination-out compositing.
- Undo removes the latest committed stroke.
- Reset clears all committed strokes.
- Stroke count/progress reflects committed strokes.
- Toolbar taps must not draw accidental strokes.

## Remix target
Regenerate the public surface as **Neon Bestie Doodle Era**, a relaxing anime lo-fi neon city sketchbook. The player is a one-thumb doodler calming a satirical pastel city by drawing expressive soft-girl/decora lines. Mechanics remain freeform drawing; world, HUD, scene, feedback, fonts, palette, and media are transformed.
